lines: Have you heard about Bill? Everyone calls him a Pokemaniac!
I think people are just jealous of Bill, though.
Who wouldn't want to boast about their Pokemon?
Hi, you're a new face! Trainers who want to turn pro have to have a policy about Pokémon!
What is your approach when you catch Pokémon?
battle: My policy is an all-out offensive with water-type Pokémon!
Wow! You're too much! All right! You can have the Cascade Badge to show you beat me!
TM03 teaches Water Pulse. Use it on an aquatic Pokémon!
reward: You can also have my favorite TM!
TM03 teaches Water Pulse. Use it on an aquatic Pokémon!

lines: You're still struggling along back here? I'm doing great! I caught a bunch of strong and smart Pokémon!
battle: Here, let me see what you caught!
Hey! Take it easy! You won already!
Hey, guess what? I went to Bill and got him to show me his rare Pokémon! Since you are using his system, go thank him! Well, I better get rolling! Smell ya later!

lines: It is dangerous to go alone.
